description.describe_ch: Critical thinking is the use of reasoning to determine what is true and what is false. Accordingly, critical thinking is a valuable skill utilised in all disciplines and professions. This Critical Thinking course aims to empower students to think more clearly, insightfully and analytically about what they believe, and be more effective in arguing their views. Students will develop the ability to recognise and avoid common barriers to critical thinking; develop strategies for evaluating evidence and arguments, and learn to formulate and make sound arguments.

Also be advised: We highly value students' active participation and discusssion. Hence no absence or tardiness will be tolerated.  Abscences or over-tardiness will result in a severe deduction of the final grades.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
Students should be morally responsible for whatever is submitted to the instructor.  Late submission or no submission of assignments will result in failure in this class.   Should there be any legality involved, the students will be held solely accountable for their actions.

We also value students' active participation very much.  So absences or over-tardiness will result in the deduction of the final grades.

gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
All students should be advised that Feng Chia University tolerates no falsification of any kind.  That is, no academic dishonesty is allowed.  So, no plagrism, no copying, no use of false identity.  
 
We value students' integrity as well as their academic productions but we also punish those who violate work ethics and infringe copyrights or intellectual property rights.
